text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day is growing late as Symboli
Rudolf and I
head back after our day
out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, there's somewhere
I would
like to drop by before we return
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Would you be willing to accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The moon is supposed to be a perfect
crescent
tonight, and I hear that the sky
will be clear...
choice_data_list: Sure, but where are we going?
Sure, but where are we going?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf leads me to a shrine
located on a
small hill.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There aren't any buildings or bright
lights around
here. We should have a
perfect view.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perfect is right. A beautiful crescent
moon shines
brightly in the sky above us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I rarely speak about this, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When I was young, I was often called
Luna, on
account of the white streak in
my hair.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You could hardly imagine it now, could
you? But
it suited me then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I always loved the sound of it, and once
I learned
where it came from, I smiled
every time I caught
sight of the moon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...But that's in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I left that name behind when I resolved
to walk
the path of the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That isn't to say I mourn its loss, you
understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can't explain why, but... I simply felt
that you
ought to know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can't explain why, but... I simply felt
that you
ought to know.
choice_data_list: That's a cute name, isn't it?
I'll remember this forever, even in the days to come.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that you were so willing to
listen.
choice_data_list: That's a cute name, isn't it?
I'll remember this forever, even in the days to come.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I feel... How should I put it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's as if a burden has been lifted from
my
shoulders. My heart feels as clear as
the night air.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...We ought to head back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Trainer. Tomorrow
and
beyond...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the memory she shared still fresh in
my
mind, I quietly swear to stay by
Symboli Rudolf's
side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Be that as it may, call me that in
public and
you'll sound like a lunatic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Call me Luna, and you'll sound like...
Pffft. That's
rather good.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Luna... Lunatic...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's some quality wordplay. Perfect for
an
inside joke between comrades.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We walk back to the academy under the

moonlight, with Symboli Rudolf stifling
giggles all
the while.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That... means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's reassuring to think that, even after I
have
walked my path to its end and
made my dreams a
reality...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You will still remember who I used to be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that, I can forge ahead all the
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf smiles in the moonlight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I swear to myself that I will stay by her
side, come
what may.
